source.baseline: Current DM layout plus identical instrumentation, with date sums invalidated on every list notification.

notes: Deterministic local incoming-message fixtures; no network media or live server traffic.
SCROLL_MESSAGES=5000 is input size: the production retained window holds 1486 messages.
Short fast phases have 12 scroll steps plus possible trailing frames; timings vary between runs.
Chronological process order is retained in runOrder; compare bookkeeping counts separately from total frame timings.
